notes: Runtime theme.css is generated by scripts/assets/compile_theme_sources.php.
Theme source files under resources/themes/** are the editable source model.
Legacy bridge is disabled. Runtime theme.css is compiled from source theme files only.
Add or update theme files under resources/themes/** and recompile to publish runtime output.
Theme Architecture V1 source tree has four subdirectories: foundation/, semantic/, variants/, contracts/.
Foundation layer: primitive, neutral, reusable design values.
Semantic layer: intent-facing tokens consumed by runtime surfaces.
Variants layer: theme combination-specific overrides (light/dark x paper/liquid-glass).
Contracts layer: documentation of three-layer boundaries (source, compile/publish, runtime).
Existing flat root files (foundation.css, light.css, dark.css, etc.) remain compilation input until migration slices move values into structured subdirectory files.
